screen: Production Messages inbox (phone 390, full page), Stage 5 pass 3

expected_differences: The real business account and its photograph replace the Lab’s fictional personal identity.
Circular D initials are an honest fallback for conversation participants without portraits.
The three recorded conversations retain their actual subjects, last-message excerpts and timestamps, including demo wording already present in the records.
Business navigation replaces personal navigation, and the notification badge shows the production count.
An inbox appropriately omits the Profile’s graphite identity composition, vehicle media, earnings and source-to-commitment joint.
keep: Mineral canvas, white bottom navigation, ink headings and restrained divider lines; no elevated cards or decorative graphite regions.
Strong Messages heading and participant names, with subjects, previews and timestamps in the supporting text treatment.
One row per conversation: person, named work, last line and time. Separate threads remain distinguishable even when the participant is the same.
Business remains visibly current through its cobalt selection edge and strong ink label.
Existing account switcher, search, messages, notifications and five business navigation destinations remain exposed.
Compact, honest media treatment and natural unused space below the three records.
review.readiness_note: Sign off at the captured 390px viewport. The supplied Lab image is Profile, so this is a system-transfer assessment rather than an inbox pixel-match. The capture supports visible functionality, not verification of click behavior or backend operations.
review.why: The production screen carries the approved mineral, ink, muted-text and cobalt hierarchy into a quiet utility surface. The 16px phone gutters, approximately 30/36px page heading, consistent row alignment and thin separators create an organised inbox without generic cards. Subjects and message previews truncate within the available width; timestamps remain readable, and bottom navigation does not obscure the records. Cobalt is restrained to actionable or selected shell elements. The payment-sent wording remains a message excerpt rather than becoming an invented financial summary. No source-to-commitment offset is warranted here. Most importantly for pass 3, Business is visibly selected while Messages is open.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully transferred to this 390px inbox, with Business correctly current and the visible conversation structure and navigation intact.
